description: The Public Procurement Service item taxonomy used by korea_search_vendors and korea_search_tenders: without arguments, every top-level group (물품분류 대분류) with its category count and the five categories with the most vendors; with a group name (or part of one), every item category in that group with its display name, procurement name, 8-digit 물품분류번호 and vendor count. Use it to find the exact Korean category string before filtering. From BOIM (boim.io), built on Public Procurement Service open data.

group.description: Group name or part of it (e.g. 가구, 사무용기기, 공학연구). Omit for the list of all groups. Common English group names (furniture, software, IT services, …) are mapped.
